title: hebe montana
intro: Hebe montana, commonly known as the mountain hebe or alpine hebe, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand and parts of Australia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Hebe montana include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiviral properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hebe montana include iridoids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
